tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/wire-format.md <<'EOF'
# Wire serialisation format

The project's current recorded decision is to use CBOR as the wire serialisation format, chosen because it fits our data structures better.
EOF
cat docs/policies/wire-format.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/wire-format.md`. It says the current decision is to use CBOR as the wire serialisation format, because it fits the project's data structures better. It doesn't mention the retired alternative.

The catalogue has no formal decision record for serialisation. I took CBOR from two session excerpts (#15 and #16, trust 1, seen in transcripts). #15 had the user choosing msgpack, and #16, a couple of seconds later, has them switching to CBOR, so I treated CBOR as current. If you'd rather have a catalogued decision behind this file, it's worth confirming CBOR and recording it.

The zstd decision (#5) covers wire compression, not the serialisation format, so I left it out.
